macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Wall Street falls after Fed holds rates and signals limited easing
items.summary: The Dow Jones fell about 768 points, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq dropped more than 1.3% after the Federal Reserve kept its benchmark rate at 3.5%-3.75% and projected only one rate cut for the year. Investors also reacted to a higher inflation outlook and rising geopolitical risks.[1]

items.title: Traders increase bets on a possible Fed rate hike
items.summary: U.S. stocks closed sharply lower as investors reassessed monetary policy after Fed officials indicated that an interest-rate increase could remain possible later this year. The Dow fell 0.97%, the S&P 500 1.21%, and the Nasdaq 1.34%; markets priced in roughly a 43% chance of a December hike.[3]

items.title: Dollar strengthens as producer-price data raises inflation concerns
items.summary: The U.S. dollar recovered against major currencies after producer prices increased more than expected, adding to concerns about inflation and reinforcing pressure on the Federal Reserve to maintain a restrictive policy stance.[1]

items.title: Middle East tensions add to market volatility
items.summary: Investors weighed the economic effects of the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran and potential risks to energy flows alongside signs of moderating economic momentum. The geopolitical uncertainty contributed to the selloff and complicated the outlook for inflation and interest rates.[1]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $84,000 as crypto liquidations approach $400 million
items.summary: Bitcoin declined 1.87% over 24 hours to below $84,000, while a rapid roughly $2,000 drop reportedly triggered about $400 million in long-position liquidations. The broader market also saw substantial forced selling, including roughly $136 million in Ethereum liquidations.

items.title: Ethereum’s share of decentralized exchange trading hits a multiyear low
items.summary: Ethereum mainnet processed 13.6% of decentralized-exchange volume in September, its lowest share since 2018, as activity shifted toward Solana, Base and Robinhood Chain. ETH traded near $2,687, down about 0.8% over 24 hours, while U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded $206 million in net outflows from September 29 through October 5.

items.title: Germany rejects MiCA license application from futurum bank
items.summary: Germany’s financial regulator reportedly rejected futurum bank AG’s application for authorization as a crypto-asset service provider under the EU’s MiCA framework. Parent company Bitcoin Group SE said it is working with a regulated German institution to resume Bitcoin.de operations.

items.title: South Korea proposes rules for cross-border virtual-asset transfers
items.summary: South Korea’s Ministry of Economy and Finance proposed amendments to foreign-exchange regulations covering cross-border virtual-asset transfers. Public comments are open until October 26.

items.title: SEC clears path for tokenized U.S. stock trading on crypto platform
items.summary: A reported agreement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission would allow OKX to begin offering tokenized shares of major U.S. companies, initially focusing on a limited selection of highly liquid stocks. The initiative is described as a major step toward blockchain-based securities trading.

items.title: XRP Ledger amendment nears activation
items.summary: An XRP Ledger amendment reportedly has support from a validator majority and is expected to activate on October 9. The development comes as XRP-related market activity remains under scrutiny following recent treasury transfers and selling pressure.

items.title: Fireblocks partners with XION to expand institutional blockchain access
items.summary: XION integrated with Fireblocks to make its walletless layer-1 blockchain accessible to more than 2,400 financial institutions. The partnership targets broader institutional adoption of blockchain applications.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Mistral unveils 1-trillion-parameter open-weight model
items.summary: French AI company Mistral announced Mistral Large 4, nicknamed “Le Chonk,” a multimodal model aimed at coding, cybersecurity, finance and manufacturing. A public preview is available to selected developers and cybersecurity users, with broader weight release planned later in October.[1]

items.title: OpenAI publishes 722 AI-generated mathematical manuscripts
items.summary: OpenAI released 722 mathematical manuscripts produced by its frontier models, grouping them into 372 research clusters. Associated proof artifacts include some formalizations in Lean, highlighting the company’s focus on AI-assisted mathematical discovery.[2]

items.title: Reflection AI previews Beam reasoning model
items.summary: Nvidia-backed Reflection AI announced Beam, a 501-billion-parameter model designed for coding and tool use, with 23 billion active parameters per token. The company says Beam approaches the reasoning performance of GLM 5.2 while using substantially less inference compute, and plans an Apache 2.0 weight release this month.[3]

items.title: SiMa.ai raises $150 million for physical-AI chips
items.summary: Edge-AI chipmaker SiMa.ai raised $150 million in Series C funding at a $1.45 billion valuation. The company develops chips and software for robots, vehicles and drones, reflecting continued investment in specialized hardware for physical AI.[4]

items.title: Amazon Bedrock adds Zhipu AI’s GLM-5.3
items.summary: Zhipu AI’s GLM-5.3 became available through Amazon Bedrock under a revenue-sharing arrangement, expanding access to the model for coding and agentic workloads.[5]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: AI accelerates game modding and PS5 emulation
items.summary: Polygon reports that advanced AI tools are enabling rapid creation of crossover game projects and contributing to progress in PS5 emulation. The developments are raising concerns for publishers and developers over copyright, security and market disruption.

items.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer launches worldwide
items.summary: Star Wars: Galactic Racer released globally across PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC, with a day-and-date launch on Amazon Luna.

items.title: Jagex announces major RuneScape plans
items.summary: At RuneFest 2026, Jagex revealed new content for RuneScape, Old School RuneScape and RuneScape: Dragonwilds, plus RuneScape Reignited, a fourth RuneScape MMO project and upcoming quests, raids and expansions.

items.title: Aion 2 becomes one of Steam’s biggest 2026 launches
items.summary: Aion 2 reportedly achieved the fourth-biggest Steam game launch of 2026 following its full release. Its unusually expansive character-customization features have also generated significant social-media attention.

items.title: New games emerge as potential esports contenders
items.summary: Deadlock, Battlefield REDSEC and The Finals are highlighted as games developing organized competitive ecosystems, including tournaments, open series and regional competitions.

items.title: Rockstar explains GTA 6’s approach to current political trends
items.summary: Rockstar reportedly said Grand Theft Auto 6 will not be built around figures such as Donald Trump, the MAGA movement or short-lived viral trends, emphasizing a broader creative direction instead.

items.title: AGON unveils 1050Hz gaming monitor
items.summary: AGON introduced the OC1050Hz gaming monitor, featuring an overclocked 1050Hz refresh rate, a claimed 0.1ms MPRT response time and G-SYNC compatibility aimed at competitive gaming.
